apps.name: What Can I Do?
apps.description: Point your camera at anything and your AI suggests things to make, cook, fix or play with it.
apps.prompt: A camera app: I point it at anything, take a photo and my AI suggests five ideas of what to do with it, with steps, and I can choose a focus like cooking, crafts, fixing or games for kids.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Stack Tower 3D
apps.description: Stack sliding blocks as high as you can: overhangs are cut off and tumble down, perfect drops grow your tower.
apps.prompt: A 3D stacking game with three.js: blocks slide in from alternating sides, I tap to drop them, the part that overhangs is cut and falls, perfect drops give combos and grow the block back, rainbow colours and a camera that rises with the tower.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Neon Drift 3D
apps.description: Race down a synthwave highway at sunset: drag to dodge neon barriers and grab glowing orbs.
apps.prompt: A 3D endless racer with three.js in a synthwave style: a neon grid highway, a striped sunset sun, wireframe mountains, a glowing car I steer by dragging, neon barriers to dodge, orbs to collect and speed that keeps rising.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Castle Siege 3D
apps.description: Defend your castle wall: enemies march up the valley towards you and you shoot them down with your crossbow.
apps.prompt: A 3D castle defence game with three.js where I stand on the castle wall looking down a valley, soldiers, goblins, knights, ogres and bosses march towards me along the road, I tap to shoot crossbow bolts, and between waves I buy upgrades like more damage, faster reload, multiple bolts, fire bolts and wall repairs.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Would You Rather
apps.description: Party, silly and deep dilemmas: everyone taps their choice and you reveal how the group split.
apps.prompt: A Would You Rather party game with three decks of questions, two big colourful halves to tap, a vote counter so the whole group can vote and a reveal with percentages.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Will It Rain
apps.description: Find out at a glance whether you need an umbrella today, with the chance of rain hour by hour and the next 7 days.
apps.prompt: A weather app that answers one question: will it rain today and in the next hours. Use the free Open-Meteo API with no key, ask for the location or let me search a city, show a big friendly answer with an umbrella or sun, the chance of rain hour by hour as a chart for the next 24 hours, and the next 7 days. Texts in Spanish if the phone is in Spanish, otherwise in English. Save my last city.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Weather Now
apps.description: Current weather, the next 24 hours and 7 days for your city, with an animated sky that follows the weather.
apps.prompt: A beautiful weather app using the free Open-Meteo API with no key. Use my location or let me search a city and save it. Show the current temperature big, feels like, wind, humidity and an animated background that changes with the weather and day or night, a swipeable hourly forecast for 24 hours and the next 7 days with highs and lows. Texts in Spanish if the phone is in Spanish, otherwise in English.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Unit Converter
apps.description: Convert length, weight, temperature, volume, speed, area, data, time and fuel consumption instantly.
apps.prompt: A clean unit converter with categories for length, weight, temperature, volume, speed, area, data, time and fuel consumption, a swap button and every other unit listed below.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: UV Index
apps.description: Today's UV index as a colourful gauge, the hourly curve, the peak hour and how long until you burn for your skin type.
apps.prompt: A UV index app with the free Open-Meteo API and no key. Use my location or a searched city. Show today's UV index as a big colourful gauge, the hourly UV curve for today, the peak hour, when it is safe to be in the sun, and advice for sunscreen, hat and sunglasses for each level. Add a skin type picker to estimate minutes until sunburn. Tomorrow's max UV too.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.name: Truth or Dare
apps.description: Add the players, pick a level from kids to bold, and let the phone choose truths and dares.
apps.prompt: A Truth or Dare game for groups: add players, choose kids, friends or bold level, it picks whose turn it is and shows a truth or a dare card, all fun and friendly.
apps.author: gonzaroman

apps.description: Ten quick questions on geography, science, history, movies, sports or animals, with streaks and a 50:50.
apps.prompt: A trivia quiz with built-in questions in English and Spanish about geography, science, history, movies and music, sports and animals, ten questions per round with a 15 second timer, streak bonus, 50:50 and best score per topic.
apps.author: gonzaroman
